description: This file contains the implementation of MainActivity, which is the primary activity hosting fragments for a smart TV application. It manages navigation between different sections such as Home, EPG, Favorites, and Search, and handles user interactions with the search bar and back key behavior.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main entrypoint activity hosting the STB big-screen app, managing navigation and search interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the layout, fragment navigation buttons, back key behavior, and search action handling.

methods.name: showHome
methods.description: Replaces the content area with the HomeFragment.

methods.name: showEpg
methods.description: Replaces the content area with the EpgFragment.

methods.name: showFavorites
methods.description: Replaces the content area with the FavoritesFragment.

methods.name: showSearch
methods.description: Replaces the content area with the SearchFragment, passing the search query.
